verdicts.quote: There's no end to his questions.
verdicts.reason: This has the distinct meaning ‘an unlimited amount’, not the stated sense of a point where something stops, and belongs with the phrase no end of something.
Birth is not a general antonym of end in this sense; beginning or start would be the relevant contrast.

reviewers.summary: The entry is largely accurate and well structured. Correct the misplaced example under sense 2 and replace the inappropriate antonym cross-reference there.
